verdict.rationale: Slack documents workspace export tools (slack-docs-22/23/35/36) suitable for admins, and private-channel/DM export is technically supported for Business+/Enterprise plans. However, concrete community evidence contradicts frictionless self-service access: a Slack admin reports business customers cannot freely export chats and must apply for 'Corporate Export' approval which Slack may deny even with legal/compliance justification (slack-comm-8). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of machine-readable format details (JSON schema, API endpoints for export), and no independent evidence of a successful private-conversation export without escalation/approval friction.
